answer: The lagoon shows someone vouched, the river shows someone paid, the quartz shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. Ahead of the epoch the farm wires 27225 POA and books 9350 minutes of labour, all of it sunk before any prize is counted. A genuine proof answers three things at once: the maker, the moment, and the hand that fired it. A mask costs nothing until Marble chipper tessellated vault warrant laid upon the chapter hall sets its price, and the price is written as each tessellated vault is a year of tessera logs in the basilica ledger.
